# depot-mcp

Centralized fleet file depot with tiered NVMe/spinner storage, LanceDB vector search, and SQLite FTS5 sidecar.

## Overview
- **Ports**: 10726 (frontend), 10727 (backend + MCP)
- **Host**: Goliath PC (permanently running)
- **Storage**: NVMe fast tier (C:/D:/N:) + HDD slow tier
- **Search**: LanceDB vector search + SQLite FTS5 keyword search (sidecar)
- **Access**: REST API + MCP tools + optional SMB share

## Key Files
- `src/depot_mcp/server.py` — FastMCP + FastAPI unified gateway
- `src/depot_mcp/config.py` — Configuration and drive discovery
- `src/depot_mcp/storage/` — File store, tier manager, tier policies
- `src/depot_mcp/metadata/` — LanceDB store, FTS5 store, indexer, search
- `src/depot_mcp/tools/depot_tool.py` — Portmanteau MCP tool
- `src/depot_mcp/importers/` — Migration importers (arxiv, qcad, ahk, generic)
- `web-sota/backend/` — FastAPI REST routes
- `web-sota/frontend/` — Vite + React dashboard

## Quick Start
```powershell
# Start full stack
.\web-sota\start.ps1

# MCP server only (stdio)
uv run depot-mcp --transport stdio
```
